headline: Contact left the target company; wants a brief on messaging and explicitly declined a follow-up call

suggested_routes.label: Sales coaching
suggested_routes.rationale: The rep asked for a follow-up call after the prospect had said he would reach out himself, and the prospect refused.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C10 — "No. I said I will contact you if there is anything to discuss."
suggested_routes.output: Coaching note for Meera: when a prospect sets the terms ("send me a brief... I will get back to you"), confirm them rather than pushing for a call. Also check contact data before dialling: the record still associated Aniket with Meadowbrick, which he has left.

suggested_routes.label: Deal / partner next step
suggested_routes.rationale: The only agreed action is sending a brief on the messaging app.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C10 — "why don't you just send me a brief on the messaging app?"
suggested_routes.output: Send a short, manufacturing-relevant brief on the messaging app. Do not schedule a call. Update the contact's company.

evidence.quote: Are you calling about Meadowbrick? Yes, that's right. I don't work there anymore.
evidence.supports: The contact data is out of date.

what_established: Aniket left Meadowbrick and now works in manufacturing; he wants a brief and will initiate any further contact.
what_not_established: His new company, his role, or any need.
next_action: Send the brief; no call; correct the contact record.
uncertainty: Short call; the new company is not named.
